Attached: 1 image

Wealthfolio v3.12.0 is out! 📈 The open-source portfolio tracker brings major upgrades:

- Rebalancing worksheet with suggested trades from your allocation targets
- Fund conversion tracking & new price sources (AMFI, MOEX)
- 7 new themes, text size controls, and regional gain/loss colors

Update available on PikaPods soon.
https://github.com/wealthfolio/wealthfolio/releases/tag/v3.12.0
https://pikapods.com/pods?run=wealthfolio
#opensource #ownyourdata
